video.decoding_capability: CVI: 4K (30 fps), 6MP (20 fps), 5MP (25 fps), 4MP (30 fps), 1080P (30 fps), 720P (30 fps), 720P (60 fps); AHD: 4K (15 fps), 5MP (20 fps), 4MP (30 fps), 3MP (30 fps), 1080P (30 fps), 720P (60 fps); TVI: 3MP (30 fps), 1080P (30 fps), 720P (60 fps)

features: Analytics by Recorder (analog channels only): iMD 16CH, VCA (line crossing and intrusion) 8CH with up to 10 rules per channel, Face Detection 2CH, Face Recognition 2CH
Only one Intelligent Mode can be selected at a time; enabling one or more IP channels disables all analytics on all analog channels; IP channels do not support Analytics by Recorder
Up to 10 face picture libraries (max. 20,000 pictures)
Independent HDMI/VGA output; simultaneous mode and spot output mode
Audio input: 4-channel RCA, plus 16-channel BNC input (coaxial audio)
notes: Datasheet gives power consumption as < 15 W, HDD not included.
Datasheet gives video input as 16 analog channels or 32 IP channels; to add more than 16 IP cameras, analog channels must be converted to IP channels. No combined maximum is stated.
Datasheet key features state up to 16 TB internal storage, while the spec table states up to 16 TB per HDD (2 SATA) and the product page lists 32TB maximum internal storage.
